name: oxipng
description: Lossless PNG compression optimizer with advanced filtering and chunk optimization

tools.description: High-performance PNG optimizer that reduces file size without quality loss using advanced algorithms
tools.usage:
oxipng image.png # Optimize PNG file
oxipng -o 6 image.png # Maximum optimization level
oxipng --strip safe image.png # Remove metadata safely
oxipng -r *.png # Optimize all PNGs recursively
oxipng --alpha # Optimize alpha channel
